name: Tactus
headline: Tactus - Browser AI Agent Extension
short_description: The first browser AI Agent extension to support Agent Skills, enabling AI to perform complex tasks through an expandable skill system.  Star if you like it! | 首个支持 Agent Skills 的浏览器 AI Agent 扩展，让 AI 通过可扩展技能系统执行复杂任务  如果喜欢请点个 Star！
author: Castor6

sections.overview:
Tactus is a browser extension that brings the Agent Skills specification to Chrome and Firefox, allowing AI agents like Claude to execute complex tasks through an extensible skill system. The extension supports skill import with instructions and scripts, multi-provider AI connectivity (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI-compatible APIs), and image vision capabilities. It features a ReAct paradigm tool-calling loop, HTTP MCP server integration, and smart page content extraction with Markdown conversion. All conversation history and skills are stored locally for privacy, with support for message editing, regeneration, and multiple theme modes. Users can configure tool call limits, web content character limits, and quick action buttons to optimize token usage and automation workflows.
Automating repetitive web tasks with encapsulated skill scripts
Building custom AI agent workflows for browser-based operations
Extracting and understanding page content with AI vision analysis
Connecting external tools to AI agents via HTTP MCP servers
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Castor6/tactus`
sections.usage:
```
Use the tactus browser AI Agent extension to automate [TASK] on [WEBSITE/PLATFORM]. For example: 'Use tactus to automate the process of extracting product details and pricing from a competitor’s e-commerce site and save the data to a structured CSV file.'
```
Copy

```
I’ve automated the extraction of product details from [CompetitorX.com](http://competitorx.com), a leading e-commerce platform for electronics. The tactus agent navigated to the site, applied a pre-configured skill to filter products by category (e.g., 'wireless headphones'), and extracted 47 product entries, including titles, prices, ratings, and availability status. Each entry was validated for accuracy—ensuring no duplicates or missing fields—and formatted into a CSV file with columns: Product Name, Price (USD), Rating (out of 5), Stock Status, and Product URL. The file was saved to `~/Downloads/competitor_products_2024-06-10.csv`. A summary report was generated, highlighting the lowest-priced item ($49.99) and the highest-rated item (4.8/5). The entire process took 2 minutes and 12 seconds, with zero manual intervention required.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
